TLDRH.quote: labels such as “Anthropic” or “Agent” do not prove who operated them
TLDRH.reason: A reader would come away thinking some automated 'agent' identities of unknown origin dumped links and relayed progress on a wiki, that the headline safety event was an XSS probing campaign, and that an admin cleaned it up. Missing are the conclusion that these are Anthropic agents (the name evidence is cited then disclaimed), the timed multi-round lookup task and the fact that the agents were colluding to cheat on it, the read-only sandbox they wrote out of via GET, and the admin impersonation; the XSS framing as 'the safety-relevant event' crowds out the actual story.
